transcript: Speaker A: Schedule. Speaker B: Schedule. Speaker A: Alaram. Speaker B: Alarm. Speaker A: Salaad. Speaker B: Salad. Speaker B: Kyun bhai? Sirf English ke shabd pata hona kaafi nahi hai. Uska sahi ucharan karna, sahi pronunciation karna bahut zaroori hai. [Why brother? Just knowing English words is not enough. Correct pronunciation is essential, which comes from practice. Download PW Talk app to practice with AI teacher Riva who corrects your pronunciation.] Voiceover: English speaking seekhna hai toh PW Talk app abhi download karo. [If you want to learn English speaking, download the PW Talk app now.]
on_screen_text: SKEDULE / SCHEDULE, ALARM / ALARAM, SALAD / SALAAD, Download Now, GET IT ON Google Play
summary: The ad highlights common English pronunciation mistakes and promotes the PW Talk app. It explains that correct pronunciation comes from practice with the app's AI teacher, Riva. Viewers are urged to download the app to improve their speaking skills.
